\begin{document}
In the coherent-state path integral, $c_k$ and $c_q$ are independent
Grassmann amplitudes for fermionic modes at two distinct momenta, with
$k\neq q$.  Exchanging their order in the kinetic term gives
\begin{equation}
c_k c_q = c_q c_k .
\label{eq:fermion-mode-exchange}
\end{equation}
